author: curriculum-architect
songSummary: Practices finding E and F, counting three same notes, hearing lines that start alike, and playing together, with the blackbird pie rhyme.

classes.title: Swing with the blackbirds
classes.goal: Hear the whole song and sway to its swinging beat.

mathTarget.parentLine: Feeling a swing that comes again and again, evenly spaced

classes.parentPrompt: Sit side by side and sway together in big, slow swings to the music.
classes.childAction: Sway, and flap your wings when the birds begin to sing.
classes.bridge: The beat swings like a bird's wings: up and down, up and down.

intro.caption: Let's swing with the blackbirds
intro.parentCue: sway together in big, slow swings.

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: feeling the swinging beat, together.

classes.title: Tap the swinging beat
classes.goal: Tap one steady tap on each beat while the grown-up plays the tune.

mathTarget.parentLine: One tap for each beat, no more, no less

classes.parentPrompt: Rest your hand on your child's hand; tap together, then slowly let go.
classes.childAction: Tap any key once for every beat you hear.
classes.bridge: Each beat is one wing flap; one tap for every flap.

intro.caption: One beat, one tap
intro.parentCue: tap your child's shoulder on each beat.

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: one tap for each beat.

classes.title: E, the king's key
classes.goal: Find E by touching the two black keys, then sliding right.

mathTarget.parentLine: Two black keys help us find the same key every time

classes.parentPrompt: Guide your child's finger to touch two black keys, then slide right to E.
classes.childAction: Find the two black keys, slide right, and play E!
classes.bridge: E sits just right of the two black keys, like a king beside two guards.

intro.caption: Let's find the king's key
intro.parentCue: touch the two black keys together first.

games.caption: Sing a song: E, E, E

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: finding E by the two black keys.

classes.title: Hop up the branch
classes.goal: Copy short patterns of two or three notes, right after the grown-up.

mathTarget.parentLine: Holding a short tune in mind, then playing it back

classes.parentPrompt: Play a short pattern, then point to your child: your turn. Cheer every try.
classes.childAction: Listen to two or three notes, then play them back.
classes.bridge: E, F, G climb three white keys, like a bird hopping up a branch.

intro.caption: I play, then you echo
intro.parentCue: play first, then point to your child.

games.caption: Hop up the branch: E, F, G
games.parentCue: Play it first, then point: your turn

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: listening and playing short tunes back.

classes.title: The birds fly up!
classes.goal: Hear two lines that start the same, then one flies up high.

mathTarget.parentLine: Two lines begin the same, then one flies up high

classes.parentPrompt: Keep your hands low for the first line; lift them high when the birds fly.
classes.childAction: Listen for the birds flying up, then echo G, F, E home.
classes.bridge: The pie opens and the tune flies up high, to the right.

intro.caption: Listen: which line flies up?
intro.parentCue: lift your arms high when the tune flies up.

games.caption: Same start, two endings
games.parentCue: Raise your arms high on the last note

games.caption: Fly back home: G, F, E
games.parentCue: Point to each key as it lights

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: hearing lines that start the same.

classes.title: Wait for the E
classes.goal: Listen to the song and play E at the right moments.

mathTarget.parentLine: Waiting for your part is part of the music

classes.parentPrompt: Play the blue keys; nod to your child just before each E.
classes.childAction: Wait and listen, then play E when it's your turn.
classes.bridge: The tune sings along; E is your turn to sing too.

intro.caption: Listen for your E
intro.parentCue: nod to your child just before each E.

games.caption: Find your E
games.parentCue: Point to the key, then let them press

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: waiting for your turn, then playing.

classes.title: E and F, holding hands
classes.goal: Play two special notes, E and F, when they light up in the song.

mathTarget.parentLine: E and F sit side by side, with no black key between

classes.parentPrompt: Show your child that E and F touch, with no black key between. Then play along.
classes.childAction: Play E or F when its key lights up in the song.
classes.bridge: E and F are two white friends holding hands, no black key between.

intro.caption: Now we have two keys
intro.parentCue: point to E, then F, before the song starts.

games.caption: Dainty dish: E, E, F, F
games.parentCue: Point to the key before it lights

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: finding E and F side by side.

classes.title: A song for the king
classes.goal: Play the whole song together, the grown-up on the tune, the child on E and F.

mathTarget.parentLine: Two players keep the same beat, so the song stays together

classes.parentPrompt: Keep playing even if a note is missed; nod the beat with your head.
classes.childAction: Play your E and F while your grown-up plays the rest.
classes.bridge: You and your grown-up sing like two blackbirds, side by side.

intro.caption: Let's play it together
intro.parentCue: keep going, even if a note is missed.

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: keeping one beat with two players.

classes.title: Teddy is the king today
classes.goal: Play the whole song for teddy the king, from start to end, then bow.

mathTarget.parentLine: The same opening comes back four times, each with a new ending

classes.parentPrompt: Make teddy the king; play the whole song for him, then bow to the king.
classes.childAction: Play your E and F to the very end, then bow to the king.
classes.bridge: Sing, sing, the birds fly up, the pie opens, and the king smiles.

intro.caption: Concert time for King Teddy!
intro.parentCue: sit teddy up tall like a king.

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: playing a whole song, start to end.
